title: Library Purification with Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Verogen ForenSeq DNA Signature Prep Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the desired settings for the run, e.g., set “park tips” to yes (recommended) to conserve tips and set “track tips across protocol runs” to yes if tip racks will remain in the same state between runs.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip the files if they are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py file that contains the library‑purification script.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as follows: place the magnetic extraction plate (Abgene Midi plate) on the magnetic module in slot 11, place the elution PCR plate on the temperature module in slot 3, load the two 12‑channel reservoirs for reagents, and position any tip racks as indicated by the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine for all labware, tip racks, and the pipette, using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated library purification workflow.
